options.description: No string matching. Each session's agent is told once which built-in study tools and workflow exist. When it sees your message asks for a study, it proposes the idea through plumb itself and waits for you to pick a depth. No extra cost per message, and it still works when the judge is down.
options.label: The agent (Recommended)

options.description: The judge reads every message and decides whether it asks for a study, then plumb offers it on the band. Costs a judge call on every message, adds delay, and offers nothing when the judge can't be reached.
options.label: plumb's judge

options.description: The relayed words aren't what you meant. Nothing is reworked; you explain in your next message.
options.label: Not my answer

payload.question: The coordinator relayed your words on the study offer: "It shouldnt be parsing specific strings, just understand when a study is requested and understand what tools, workflows should be used". Who should do that understanding?
